item.title: Alberta’s Librarians Brace for a New Era of ‘Book Bans’
item.description: A new provincial law requires public libraries to pull and restrict items with “graphic visual depictions of sexual acts.” Librarians argue the mandate opens the door to censorship.

item.title: European Countries Push, Again, To Deport Migrants to Rwanda
item.description: Five European nations are closing in on a plan to send rejected migrants to Rwanda following a failed U.K. deal with the country.

item.title: A Trump-Putin-Xi Summit? That Might Be Awkward for One of Them.
item.description: A summit could bolster Xi Jinping’s stature. But talks about Ukraine’s future and limits on nuclear weapons pose uncomfortable choices for China.

item.title: Who’s Hiding Secrets About Dag Hammarskjöld’s Death?
item.description: The U.N. leader died in a plane crash in 1961. Many suspect foul play, but a lot of information still remains secret.

item.title: U.S. Global Health Strategy Jeopardizes Prevention of Pandemics, Experts Warn
item.description: The Trump administration has been negotiating agreements with dozens of individual countries. Public health experts say a global agreement would be far more effective.
